guarantees.claim: theta_data[i] is always equal to theta(phase1_in[i]) for every share.
pi_data[i] is always equal to pi(rho_data[i]) for every share.

assumptions.claim: rho_data[i] must be driven by external logic for each share, as the rho function call is commented out.
assumptions.risk: if rho_data is undriven or uninitialized, pi_data[i] becomes X, corrupting the Keccak state and potentially leaking or invalidating masked data.

uncertain_points.claim: rho_data[i] is used in the pi assignment but the rho function call is commented out; it is not locally assigned and no evidence shows it is driven elsewhere.
uncertain_points.cond: if rho_data is not connected in another module or block
uncertain_points.risk: permanently undriven rho_data leads to X propagation through pi_data, breaking the cryptographic permutation and compromising mask integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: The chi and iota steps of Phase 2 are not implemented in this generate block and must be provided by later logic.
uncertain_points.risk: if those steps are missing or incorrectly connected, the Keccak permutation will be incomplete, leading to incorrect hash/KMAC output.
